utfall: Relativ risiko for uføretrygd ved 29 år ved depresjonsdiagnose 22–26 år
sitat: Among those who had completed upper secondary school at age 21 years, depression increased the risk of low income (1.71; 1.60–1.83), prolonged unemployment benefit (2.17; 2.03–2.31), social security benefit (3.62; 2.91–4.51) and disability pension (4.43; 3.26–6.01) compared with those with no depression.

utfall: Relativ risiko for sosialhjelp ved 29 år ved depresjonsdiagnose 22–26 år (uføretrygd ikke oppgitt for gruppen i sammendraget)
sitat: For people who had not completed upper secondary school at age 21 years, a depression diagnosis at age 22–26 increased the risk of low income (relative risk = 1.33; 95% confidence interval = 1.25–1.40), prolonged unemployment benefit (1.46; 1.38–1.55) and social security benefit (1.56; 1.41–1.74) at age 29 compared with those with no depression.
